data.name: Cold Doctor & Noble Lady Fall for Me
data.detailed_description:
Cold Doctor & Noble Lady Fall for Me - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core Plot Introduction: Simon, who was 22 years old, should have died in the explosion of the FX Group's secret laboratory, but he was reborn after merging with No. 7. In the ward on the third basement floor of Zurich University Hospital, he began to fight against his fate. With the power of No. 7, he borrowed others' senses and had a wonderful connection with nurse Tessa, volunteer Maria, and doctor Katya. Facing the pursuit of the FX Group, the three of them formed an alliance to jointly seek a chance of survival.
Worldview Atmosphere: The story constructs a world full of cyberpunk elements. Concepts such as silver - blue nano - streams, consciousness colonization, and singularity residues add a strong science - fiction color to the story. The third basement floor of the hospital is filled with the smell of disinfectant and damp cement, which is depressing and mysterious, forming a sharp contrast with the surveillance and threats in the outside world.
Highlights of Female Character Interactions: Nurse Tessa's professional efficiency and faint exhaustion, Maria's mature charm and vulnerability after being suppressed, and Katya's rational strength and inner pain. The three female characters each have their own charm. The interactions between Simon and them are full of emotional collisions and subtle changes. From the initial exploration to the later trust, it shows a complex and touching emotional relationship.
Tension in Character Relationships: Simon's merger with No. 7 makes his consciousness complex. There is not only a need for cooperation between him and Maria and Katya, but also mutual suspicion and exploration. Between Maria and Katya, the collision between mature charm and rational strength also creates a tense and subtle relationship. The tension in these character relationships adds many suspense and highlights to the story.
Scene Features: Scenes such as the hospital ward, the logistics passage, and the lakeside mansion each have their own characteristics. In the hospital ward, the monotonous sound of the electrocardiogram monitor and the smell of disinfectant create a tense atmosphere; in the logistics passage, the night wind wrapped in the wet and cold air of Lake Zurich adds a sense of urgency to the escape; the private lounge in the lakeside mansion is isolated from the outside world by thick curtains, becoming their temporary haven.
Immersive Experience: Players will follow Simon's perspective and delve into this world full of science - fiction and suspense. By borrowing others' senses, players can feel the inner world and physical state of different characters, as if they are on the scene. The tense plot, complex character relationships, and suspense - filled episodes make players immerse themselves in it and unable to extricate themselves.
High - definition Visual Performance: The game uses high - definition CG technology to delicately show the appearance, expressions, and actions of characters, as well as the details of various scenes. Special effects such as silver - blue nano - streams and golden cyber lines add a gorgeous visual effect to the game.
Functional Gameplay Features: The game supports offline play, allowing players to enjoy the game anytime and anywhere. The one - key backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important episodes, the automatic play function allows players to easily browse the plot, and the chapter browsing function allows players to quickly locate the parts they are interested in. The smooth reading experience allows players to focus on the development of the story.
